column1: # CHAOS-13958: race-leg placement apart rules (ci/go_race_shard.awk apart=, the race legs only). Format: kind<TAB>package<TAB>value.
# heavy<TAB>package<TAB>seconds: a race package whose median hosted race time is 300 s or more. The plan puts at most one heavy
# package on a leg, and none on a leg that holds a listed part: three of them in one parallel batch ran 1.2-2.0x their time alone
# (Go quality 44091722883, 44105231987, 44118503347: race leg 13 walls 881, 1037, 1280 s). Seconds = the median of the package's
# go test "ok" seconds in those three main push runs, rounded up.
# part<TAB>package<TAB>part: a serial race part (ci/go_race_splits.tsv) whose leg takes no heavy package (its 192-365 s run alone
# after the batch adds to the heavy package's wall).
# Sorted (LC_ALL=C), no duplicates. A heavy row names a race package that is not split, solo or pinned.
